brief: Prioritise Penrose Park 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-337) for pre-event attention ahead of younger units in similar condition, as it is an ageing unit of advanced age with a history of high loading and reduced margin against mechanical failure as outlined in MG-023. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the forecast heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure per MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period according to MG-021.
